name: Qi Sili
source: He is an internationally renown top designer. Ten years ago, after taking the fashion world by storm with a show that changed the direction of the entire industry, he retired. Having accepted Evan's invitation due to certain circumstances, he has made his comeback as the director of Warson Group's Design Department, and is responsible for all the high-end lines by Warson. He is also the main character's supervisor and mentor.
